items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was very good. Ed Shaughnessy. ... Ed Shaughnessy, Grady Tate, it was another drummer... Ed Shaughnessy was the main drummer, right? For the Tonight Show? Yeah.

ctx.x: He was very good. Ed Shaughnessy. In New York they had… could you remember the guys they had in New York? They had the drummer… Sonny, no not Sonny Payne, but…oh man…
Drummer right? We‘re looking at the drummers. Mel Lewis…
